result.note: An institutional governance story with little durable detail, so one question tests which aviation regulator the ministry reprimanded.

questions.prompt: In July 2026, the Ministry of Civil Aviation reprimanded which body for failing to stop its officials influencing jobs for their relatives in the aviation sector?
questions.explain: The ministry rebuked the Directorate General of Civil Aviation (DGCA), India's aviation safety body, over weak conflict-of-interest controls. As of January 31, 51 DGCA officials had disclosed 59 relatives working in aviation.
questions.source: India's Ministry of Civil Aviation has reprimanded the Directorate General of Civil Aviation (DGCA) for failing to stop officials influencing jobs for their relatives in the sector.
